intro: Chicago is the best all-round listening city in the American interior. O'Hare and Midway sit inside one of the world's busiest terminal areas, the city is the freight-rail crossroads of North America with six Class I railroads meeting here, and Lake Michigan gives you a full Coast Guard sector and a marine band that stays busy all summer. The lake also does something unusual for radio: over-water paths let a handheld reach Michigan and Indiana from the shoreline.
introz: 芝加哥是美国内陆综合收听体验最好的城市。奥黑尔和中途机场处在全球最繁忙的终端区之一；这座城市是北美货运铁路的十字路口，六家一级铁路在此交汇；密歇根湖带来一个完整的海岸警卫队分区，整个夏季海事频段都很忙。湖面还带来一个对无线电很特别的好处：越水路径让手台从岸边就能覆盖到密歇根和印第安纳。

stations.d: O'Hare runs multiple tower positions across a huge runway complex. Sweep 118–127 MHz to find the active ones; the sequencing on a busy evening is extraordinary to follow.
stations.dz: 奥黑尔在庞大的跑道群上同时开多个塔台席位。扫 118–127 MHz 找当前在用的；繁忙傍晚的排序过程听起来非常震撼。

stations.d: The quickest way to hear the actual wind and runway configuration, which at O'Hare changes the whole operation.
stations.dz: 最快了解实际风向和跑道构型的方式——在奥黑尔，这决定了整个机场的运行方式。

stations.d: Short runways wedged into a residential grid. Steep, tight approaches and a very different feel from O'Hare.
stations.dz: 被居民区网格挤住的短跑道。进近陡而紧凑，与奥黑尔感觉完全不同。

stations.d: Two major airports plus a ring of satellites in one terminal area. Sweep 119–127 MHz.
stations.dz: 两座大型机场加一圈卫星机场共用一个终端区。扫 119–127 MHz。

stations.d: Small fields ring the metro. Also try 122.700 and 123.000.
stations.dz: 都会区周边有大量小机场。也可试 122.700 和 123.000。

stations.d: More freight tonnage passes through Chicago than anywhere else in North America. BNSF, Union Pacific, CSX, Norfolk Southern, Canadian National and Canadian Pacific Kansas City all meet here, all on analog AAR channels. Rochelle, Blue Island and the Belt Railway yards are legendary listening spots — bring the whole band and a folding chair.
stations.dz: 经过芝加哥的货运吨位超过北美任何地方。BNSF、联合太平洋、CSX、诺福克南方、加拿大国家铁路和 CPKC 全在此交汇，全部使用模拟 AAR 频道。Rochelle、Blue Island 和 Belt Railway 编组场是传奇的收听地点——把整个频段带上，再带一张折叠椅。

stations.d: Metra runs eleven lines out of downtown. Union Station is dense with traffic.
stations.dz: Metra 从市中心发出十一条线路，联合车站通话密集。

stations.d: Safety broadcasts and search and rescue. The Coast Guard is genuinely busy here in summer.
stations.dz: 安全通告与搜救。夏季海警在这里确实很忙。

stations.d: Sailboats, charter fishing, the Chicago Yacht Club and commercial traffic. Excellent from Navy Pier or the lakefront path.
stations.dz: 帆船、包船海钓、芝加哥游艇俱乐部和商船。在海军码头或湖滨步道收听效果极佳。

stations.d: The Chicago River bridge lifts are coordinated here, which is a genuinely charming thing to listen to in spring and autumn.
stations.dz: 芝加哥河的开合桥升降在这里协调，春秋两季听起来颇有意趣。

stations.z: 海事 09 频道 · 呼叫

stations.d: Severe thunderstorm and tornado warnings in summer, lake-effect snow in winter. The nearshore forecast matters if you are on the water.
stations.dz: 夏季有强雷暴和龙卷警报，冬季有湖效应降雪。在水上活动时，近岸预报很重要。

stations.d: The over-water path across the lake gives a shoreline handheld unusual reach toward Michigan and Indiana.
stations.dz: 越湖水路径让岸边手台向密歇根和印第安纳方向的覆盖格外可观。

stations.d: Several machines on downtown high-rises give metro-wide coverage. Confirm on RepeaterBook for Cook County.
stations.dz: 市中心多座高层上的中继覆盖整个都会区。请在 RepeaterBook 查 Cook County 确认。

stations.z: 芝加哥警消 · 数字集群
stations.d: Chicago's public safety radio has moved to digital trunked operation. Not practical on a VX-6.
stations.dz: 芝加哥的公共安全电台已迁到数字集群，VX-6 不具备实用性。

stations.d: Very active during the summer festival season in Grant Park.
stations.dz: 夏季 Grant 公园的音乐节期间非常活跃。

stations.d: The station that produced This American Life and Serial.
stations.dz: 制作了《This American Life》和《Serial》的电台。

stations.d: One of the country's best student freeform stations, with a legendary jazz and experimental tradition.
stations.dz: 全美最好的学生自由形式电台之一，爵士与实验音乐传统深厚。

stations.n: WGN 720 AM — and the night band
stations.d: A 50 kW clear-channel station audible across much of North America at night. Chicago is a great place to appreciate how far AM travels after dark — sweep 530–1710 kHz and see how many states you can collect.
stations.dz: 50 千瓦清晰频道台，夜间在北美大部分地区都能收到。芝加哥很适合体会中波入夜后能传多远——扫 530–1710 kHz，看能收到多少个州。

stations.d: The lakefront gives you a clean eastern horizon with no terrain.
stations.dz: 湖滨提供东面无地形遮挡的干净地平线。
